answer: An agent keeps a seat only by rooting one vine, tagged at the nursery to that key alone, on a terrace closed to every other key for 36 hours. A clerk must wander the closed row and read that tag from the living stem. As an example, 6 fake keys would each need their own terrace, vine, and walk, since one clerk cannot read two stems at once. A tag already scanned, or a terrace with no rooted stem, fails the check.
